title: Totals from Lists
goal: By the end of this lesson you will know how to add up the numbers in a list with a running total inside a for loop.
learn: Add each list number to the total
Print the final sum after the loop
idea: To add up everything in a list of numbers, keep a running total. Start it at 0, and on each pass of the loop add the current number with total = total + score. When the loop ends, total holds the sum of every item.
changeOneLine: In the editor above, change the last score from 65 to 70 and press Run. The total should become 321.

practice.text: Add up all the prices and print the total.
practice.hint: Make a for loop that visits each price, and add each one to total inside the loop.
practice.starterTip: Try for price in prices: then total = total + price (indented) before the final print.
practice.starter:
prices = [3, 5, 2, 4]
total = 0
# for loop to add each price

print("Total:", total)
practice.gradingNote: Pass if a for loop adds each price into total and prints 14.

practice.text: Find the sum of points. Print only the final total.
practice.hint: points has three numbers. Loop over points and add each number into total before you print.
practice.starterTip: Add for p in points: and total = total + p (indented) between total = 0 and print(total).
practice.gradingNote: Pass if total becomes 60 via a loop that adds each point.

quiz.question: Why start total = 0 before the loop?

options.text: So you have a starting sum to add into
Because lists must begin at zero
Python requires total to be a string

quiz.correct: Right, zero is the empty sum before you add any numbers.
quiz.wrong: You need a starting value before you add each item.

quiz.question: What does total = total + score do?

options.text: Adds score onto the running total

quiz.correct: Yes, it grows the total by the current score.
quiz.wrong: This is the classic running total pattern.

quiz.question: When should you print the final total?
quiz.correct: Right, after the loop total includes every item.
quiz.wrong: Print after all the numbers have been added.
